name: Qualcomm
status: NEW PRIORITY RESEARCH / DO NOT CHASE
themeGroup: AI / Data centres + Robotics / Physical AI
thesis: Qualcomm is becoming a differentiated AI infrastructure candidate through power-efficient inference silicon, optical connectivity and its broader edge/industrial platform rather than another direct GPU duplicate. The Amazon collaboration materially improves customer validation, while automotive, industrial/networking and robotics diversify the path beyond handsets.

freshEvidence.evidence: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation collaboration for customized silicon supporting AI inference plus optical connectivity up to 1.6T and future generations.
Reuters reports Amazon can purchase up to $60bn of Qualcomm AI data-centre chips/related products and received warrants worth about $4bn at a $161.26 exercise price.
Qualcomm targets >$15bn data-centre revenue and $40bn non-handset revenue by FY2029; automotive target $10bn and IoT >$14bn, including industrial/networking/robotics.

whyDifferentiated: The exposure spans inference, interconnect/optics, automotive, industrial edge and robotics. That is a different economic stack from GPU training and from pure data-centre construction.
qualityPositives: Optical connectivity adds a bottleneck exposure
Existing automotive/IoT businesses diversify execution risk
risks: Handset weakness and Apple modem insourcing
Execution versus entrenched AI accelerators/custom silicon
Customer concentration if the data-centre ramp is hyperscaler-led
macroSensitivity: Positive to funded AI capex and networking demand; negative to high real yields mainly through valuation rather than near-term solvency. Semiconductor/input inflation can pressure margins. Strong cash generation should make it more resilient than pre-revenue AI infrastructure.
confirmation: Data-centre revenue ramps toward FY2027/FY2029 targets
Margins and FCF remain healthy through diversification
Handset declines are offset by non-handset growth
invalidation: Non-handset growth fails to offset handset decline
Valuation embeds the full FY2029 target too early
nextWork: Build current valuation vs historical/peer multiples
Assess Amazon warrant dilution and customer concentration
Set technical support/entry zone after the post-news tape settles
action: Research priority only. Do not promote to an actionable buy until valuation, FCF and entry-zone work are complete.
